name: dashboard-design
description: Clean, honest, wordless dashboard UI for Claude Code: KPI cards, charts, heatmaps, bullet graphs, comparison periods, ranked breakdowns, date range pickers, filters, empty states, wide and phone layouts, and a screenshot QA pass with a words audit and a salience test. Distilled from 127 shipped dashboards and the field's classics (Few, Tufte, Knaflic, NN/g).
